significance: A Chola-era Shiva temple in the Vyasarpadi quarter of Chennai, entered through a three-tier rajagopuram. Its sanctum is pierced by a lingam-shaped aperture that admits sunlight, and its tank is called Bhrama or Surya Theertham.
story: The sun god is said to have worshipped here and bathed in the tank to be freed of his Brahma-dosham, while the sage Vyasa's worship at the site is said to have given the neighbourhood its name.
